runtimeStore.separation: Runtime tables are append-only and are never loaded into crk_agent_doc.

intelligenceGovernance.scope: public or explicitly authorized documents and evidence-backed knowledge candidates

osintCollection.resultBoundary: OSINTItem records are untrusted pending-review material and are never loaded into crk_agent_doc or a trusted knowledge projection directly.
safeFetch: reject private, loopback, local, and reserved DNS answers
bounded timeout, response bytes, and item count
RSS/Atom only; reject DOCTYPE and ENTITY
do not fetch arbitrary entry links
osintCollection.topic: equipment technology, procurement, budgets, and defence industry dynamics

intelligenceGovernance.publicationAuthority: Only an authorized publisher may create PublishedKnowledgeVersion after evidence and conflict checks; extraction Agent and LLM cannot authorize or execute.

eventEnvelope.replay: Trace is rebuilt from events ordered by seq; read models are disposable projections.

authorityRules: The public-source OSINT collector may create only OSINTTask/OSINTItem evidence records; it cannot write trusted knowledge, issue Authorization, or invoke Effectors.
Every OSINTItem must pass the existing human candidate review and publication gate before it can contribute to a knowledge version.
HumanDecision records the operator choice and never grants authority.
Only an active Gate agent may emit Authorization.
Effectors require an active allow Authorization and abort on expiry, revocation, unsafe state, or connectivity loss.
Every state transition is represented by a new event; prior events are immutable.
